summary: This note is a short biographical entry on Pamela Joan "Pam" Boyd-Petroski, an American former handball player. It gives her birth date and place and notes that she competed at the 1984 Summer Olympics.
one_line: Pamela Boyd-Petroski is an American former handball player born in 1955 who competed at the 1984 Summer Olympics.
key_facts: Pamela Joan "Pam" Boyd-Petroski was born on September 27, 1955.
Pamela Joan "Pam" Boyd-Petroski was born in Atlantic City, New Jersey.
Pamela Joan "Pam" Boyd-Petroski is an American former handball player.
Pamela Joan "Pam" Boyd-Petroski competed in the 1984 Summer Olympics.
